newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.521 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.521 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims rose to 1.521 percent from 1.501 percent on the previous issue, the Swiss National Bank said.
The new series 3.375, to be paid for on February 27, allocated 1.115 billion Swiss francs ($762.2 million) at the price of 99.617.

The previous issue of three-month claims series 3.374 paid for on February 20 raised 1.063.3 billion francs and was priced at 99.622 to yield 1.501 percent annually. -- Zurich editorial, +41 1 258 7340 ($ = 1.462 Swiss Francs)
